title: What happens after the chat?
lines: The conversation ends, but the files, unfinished tasks, and decisions still need somewhere to live.
AssistOS explores a proposed workplace for continuing collaboration between people and AI workers.

emotionalPlan.purpose: Keep a conversation beside a continuing project, leaving its unfinished work visibly present.
voiceDirections: An inviting, concrete opening; gentle emphasis on the surprising contrast, with no announcer voice or theatrical suspense.

title: A place for continuing work
lines: The book begins with useful assignments: revising a document, checking research, or making a reviewable code change.
It asks how a worker can keep its role and history while the tools underneath it change.

title: The project and its decisions
lines: Shared projects connect conversation with the actual objects being worked on and the people reviewing them.
Permissions, interruptions, and recovery become part of the experience, alongside the convenience of delegated work.

title: Follow one assignment
lines: For readers imagining everyday AI collaboration, the appeal is a coherent direction for work that persists.
Begin with one bounded assignment, and follow what must remain available after the chat is over.

emotionalPlan.purpose: End on the persistent worker and project; avoid simulating unverified installed product functionality.
